newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus grain harvest nears completion, beats 1995.
newsitem.headline: Belarus grain harvest nears completion, beats 1995.

text.p: Belarus has nearly completed its grain harvest with the state sector bringing in 6.0 million tonnes of grain against last year's figure of 5.6 million tonnes, the deputy prime minister said.
Vladimir Garkun told a news conference late Thursday that private grain farmers were likely to bring in a further 400,000 tonnes, making the total 6.4 million tonnes.
Government officials had been forecasting a total harvest of 6.1 million tonnes.
Garkun said grain yields stood at 2.50 tonnes per hectare up from 2.25 tonnes per hectare in 1995.
He said Belarus had so far sowed 1.147 million hectares with winter wheat, compared to 1.408 million hectares last year.
